data.name: Kurayb
data.gender_notes: Kurayb is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: The one who is humble and obedient
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'K-R-B' meaning 'to be low, humble, or obedient'. This name is mentioned in a Hadith where a man named Kurayb is given the good news of Paradise for his humility and obedience. The name Kurayb carries the meaning “The one who is humble and obedient” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kurayb usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who is humble and obedient and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes humility and obedience to Allah
data.etymology: Kurayb belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The one who is humble and obedient.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kurayb total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
